sections.title: Localization of Categories
sections.extract: This section is devoted to the general theory of Ore localization of categories. We are given a category A and a multiplicatively closed set of morphisms S ⊆A. The localized category AS, gotten by formally inverting the morphisms in S, always exists. The goal is to have a presentation of the morphisms of AS as left or right fractions. In Section 7 we shall apply the results of this section to triangulated categories.
